title: Registration challenge
alternativeQuestions: I cannot register my courses
Why is my course registration not working?
My courses are not showing for registration
answer: Record the academic year and semester, list every affected course code, and capture the exact message shown by the registration system. Submit a Registration Challenge request with screenshots and any payment or clearance evidence.

title: Request for deferment
alternativeQuestions: How do I defer my programme?
I want to defer my studies
Can I pause my programme?
answer: State the academic year and semester from which the deferment should take effect, the requested period, and the reason. Submit the request with relevant supporting documents for Student Support Services to process.

title: Resumption after deferment
alternativeQuestions: How do I return after deferment?
I want to resume after deferment
My deferment has ended
answer: Confirm that the approved deferment period has ended. Provide the deferment approval letter or reference, the deferred period, your programme, and the academic year and semester in which you want to resume.

title: Resumption after rustication
alternativeQuestions: How do I return after rustication?
My rustication period has ended
I want to resume after suspension
answer: Provide the rustication decision or reference, the stated end date, evidence that any stated conditions have been completed, and the academic year and semester in which you want to resume.

title: Transcript request
alternativeQuestions: How can I request my transcript?
Where is my transcript?
I need an academic transcript
answer: Confirm whether the transcript should be sent electronically or physically. Keep the application receipt, payment reference, application date, and the complete destination address ready when submitting the request.

title: Incomplete or missing result
alternativeQuestions: My result is missing
I have an incomplete result
A course result has not appeared
answer: Confirm the course code, academic year and semester. Attach the result slip or screenshot and any earlier correspondence. Submit the matter after checking that the published result-correction period has passed.

title: Fees or payment problem
alternativeQuestions: My payment is not reflecting
I have a fee payment problem
The portal has not credited my payment
answer: Check that the transaction reference and amount match your student account. Attach the receipt, transaction reference, date, amount, and a screenshot of the student account when reporting the problem.

title: Change of study centre
alternativeQuestions: How do I change my study centre?
I want to transfer to another centre
Can I move to a different study centre?
answer: Provide your current study centre, proposed study centre, reason for the change, and the semester from which the change should apply. Student Support Services will process and monitor the request.

title: Assessment, project work or teaching-practice issue
alternativeQuestions: I have a project work problem
I have an assessment problem
I need help with teaching practice
answer: Identify the course code or activity, academic period, responsible department, relevant dates, and the specific outcome you need. Attach any score sheet, message or departmental correspondence that supports the matter.

title: Certificate issue
alternativeQuestions: How do I obtain my certificate?
My certificate is not ready
I have a certificate problem
answer: Confirm the programme name, completion or graduation year, and the required collection or delivery method. Include any earlier certificate correspondence when submitting the request.
